claim: support {1, 2, 3, 4}: the complementarity system of LCP(R-hat, 0) has no solution whose support is exactly these players, i.e. there is no z_S > 0 with R-hat[S,S] z_S = 0 and R-hat[S^c,S] z_S >= 0, where R-hat is the shifted unilateral matrix on the normal players. The exported point is the pair (y, l) with l >= 0; the conditions below are the linear forms v_i = (R-hat[S,S]^T y - R-hat[S^c,S]^T l)_i, whose coefficients are the payoff entries, together with the sign conditions on l. Any such z_S would give <z_S, v> = <R-hat[S,S] z_S, y> - <l, R-hat[S^c,S] z_S> <= 0, while z_S > 0 against a non-negative v with a positive sum forces <z_S, v> > 0. Conjoined over all supports this is A3: LCP(R-hat, 0) has only the trivial solution, which by [SS] Lemma 2.10 is what rules out a vanishing-stationary approach (docs/THEOREM_COVERAGE.md, item A3).
